(search tool summary, not a quote:) The search didn't turn up any official documentation on the "Edit with Lovable" badge itself. The closest matches are:
- The button appears on shared projects. An Italian Substack analysis of Lovable's growth says every project has an "Edit with Lovable" button, letting you click and immediately make a copy.
- It spread through a viral site generator. The same article says a personal-site generator built on Lovable produced 20,000 sites in a few days, and each site carried the "Edit with Lovable" button, which drove the growth.
- Removing the badge is a paid feature. A third-party pricing listing includes "Remove the Lovable badge" among the features of a paid tier, though it doesn't say which tier or confirm the current price. Custom domains and private projects also appear in that list.
- Free-plan hosting is limited. A review says a free account publishes to a lovable.app address and nothing else.
Treat the badge-removal and tier details as unverified. They come from a reseller page, not Lovable's own pricing.

(search tool summary, not a quote:) I couldn't find an official count of how many apps are deployed to lovable.app subdomains. Sacra reports over 1.2 million apps built since launch and 4,000+ instances continuously hosted on fly.io (secondary research source). An older Dealroom note says Lovable builds 1,000+ apps daily (undated). A Bluesky post claims over 100K applications created and deployed (out of date, unverified). Lovable's FAQ says the default Lovable subdomain (xxx.lovable.app) cannot be removed, and it stays reachable even when custom domains are connected. A third-party guide adds that publishing to a lovable.app subdomain costs nothing beyond your subscription, on every plan including Free.
